rows.name:
Dodora admires the bird people and had the idea of making
a headpiece with High Entia feathers found in Achamoth.
He still needs more feathers, so give him a hand.

In Imperial Capital Achamoth,
look for 5 [System:Color name=item ]High Entia Feathers[/System:Color].

Dodora was overjoyed to have the High Entia feathers.
What kind of headpiece will he end up making?
